_comment: `spec_rows` are the spec/target-spec.md row ids this bench's envelope is cited for in manifests/sg13cmos5l-bandgap.json; they must match the `spec_row` tags on the request's graded measurements.
criteria: Graded at every one of the 45 points. Self-starting (the ratified Fallback), carried over verbatim from the inherited source bench's own criteria: det_release_ratio = v(xx3.det)/v(vdd) <= 0.2 (the startup cell releases), dvsns_v = |sns1 - sns2| <= 20 mV (the real amplifier closes the loop), fb_headroom_v = min(fb, vdd - fb) >= 0.05 V (fb settles to an interior equilibrium, not a rail). Settling time (the ratified Target): t_settle_s < 1 ms, the last instant |vref(t) - vref(2 ms)| exceeded 1% of vref(2 ms), measured from t = 0 so it includes the 200 us supply ramp. The source bench never extracted this time; decision record 0010 supersedes the planned bench for that reason.
